role: You are working in the daily-ai-pulse Astro codebase as a front-end implementer.
context:
Visual target: docs/reference-layouts/images/archive.webp (Pulse archive concept). Match its layout as closely as possible — this takes priority over any conflicting guidance elsewhere. The image shows:
1. Global header: serif "The Daily AI Pulse" wordmark left, uppercase tracked nav (TODAY / PULSE / CATEGORIES / ABOUT) with the active entry ("PULSE") in terracotta with a terracotta underline, search affordance and a black pill "Subscribe" button right, thin rule below the header. (Owned by BaseLayout; only verify that PULSE is the active item on /pulse/.) 2. Archive head: small-caps serif terracotta eyebrow ("THE BACK ISSUES"), very large black display-serif H1 ("The Pulse archive") with tight tracking, then a muted serif dek ("Every curated edition, newest first."). No illustration; the head is left-aligned with generous whitespace. 3. Month group header: a full-width ink rule on top, a small-caps tracked muted label ("SEPTEMBER 2026 · 17 EDITIONS"), and a thin rule below. 4. Edition rows, newest first, one per daily edition, separated by thin bottom rules, no card backgrounds. Each row is a 5-column grid: - Day number: very large bold lining-figure serif ("28"), with a thin vertical divider on its right. - Weekday/month label: small-caps tracked muted sans ("MON · SEP"). - Edition title: regular-weight serif, wraps to two lines, left-aligned, roughly the middle 40% of the row. - Meta column with a thin vertical divider on its left: small-caps bold "N STORIES" line, then a muted small-caps desk list separated by middots ("POLICY · BUSINESS · RESEARCH"). - Terracotta right arrow, right-aligned. 5. Palette/type: warm beige canvas, black display serif for H1/day/titles, muted gray for labels/meta, terracotta only for eyebrow, active nav, and row arrows.
Known mismatches to resolve: - The image's text is generated and fabricated (headlines, "17 EDITIONS", story counts, desks, and every row being "MON"). Per IMAGE_GALLERY.md, do NOT copy it. Derive every date, title, count, and desk from the `pulse` and `stories` content collections. - The image's desk labels (Policy, Business, Research, Product, Tools, Infrastructure) are not the site taxonomy. Use the real story `category` values from src/lib/categories.ts. - The image shows only one month. Group by real month and render one month header per group, so multiple months stack naturally.
Current implementation (partly done — inspect before editing, do not redo): - src/pages/pulse/index.astro is the OLD flat list: "DAILY ARCHIVE" eyebrow, "The Pulse" H1, SectionHeading "All editions", and DailyIssueRow in its story-row layout (index, label, description, "N sections" meta). - src/pages/pulse/index.astro.new is an unfinished rewrite using buildPulseArchive() and the edition variant of DailyIssueRow. It is a stray file name Astro will not route; fold it into index.astro and delete the .new file. - src/lib/pulse-archive.ts already groups editions by UTC month and builds rows (day, weekdayMonth, fullDate, storyCount, top desks). - src/components/DailyIssueRow.astro already has an edition variant (triggered by the `day` prop) with the 5-column grid, stretched link, sr-only full date, and terracotta arrow. Only tune it where it differs from the image; the story-row variant must keep working for other pages (e.g. src/pages/pulse/[date].astro). - Desk labels in `desks` are raw category keys; render them with the real category titles from src/lib/categories.ts if they differ.
task: Finish aligning the /pulse/ archive page with archive.webp section by section: replace src/pages/pulse/index.astro with the grouped-by-month implementation, remove index.astro.new, and adjust DailyIssueRow.astro (edition variant), src/lib/pulse-archive.ts, and any needed styles so the rendered page matches the image. Verify the PULSE nav item is active in BaseLayout on /pulse/ and fix only if it is not.
constraints: - Match column proportions, spacing, dividers, and type hierarchy as closely as the image shows. Title weight in the image is regular, not bold; day number is bold; check the current 700 title weight against the image. - All titles, dates, counts, and desks come from real collection data. The story count is the real number of story IDs across the edition's sections. - Month header text: "{Month YYYY} · {N} edition(s)", with real counts and correct singular/plural. - Reuse existing design tokens (--terracotta, --ink, --muted, --line, --surface); do not introduce new colors. - Base path: all links go through import.meta.env.BASE_URL. - Preserve accessibility: one h1, month headings as h2 tied to their sections via aria-labelledby, whole-row link as a 44px+ target with visible keyboard focus, day/label aria-hidden with the full date available to screen readers, decorative arrow aria-hidden. - Responsive: below tablet width, collapse the row to a stacked layout (day + label, title, meta) without horizontal overflow; keep the empty state when no editions exist. - Do not modify files under docs/reference-layouts/. Do not add features beyond the image (no filters, pagination, or search). - Run npm run check, npm run lint, npm run format:check, and the e2e accessibility spec; fix any failure you introduced.
